mosaic: Relaxing jigsaw puzzles: 60 original pictures to solve at your own pace.

Mosaic is a relaxing jigsaw game with 60 original illustrations: sea, mountains, towns, animals and more.

• 60 pictures, from 12 to 48 pieces
• Drag pieces, or tap a piece and then its spot
• Edge-pieces filter
• Picture preview and zoom
• Your collection of finished pictures
• Calm original music
• No timer

The game is free and shows a few ads: never at start, one full-screen ad every few levels.
plegma: Fill the lines and clear the grid in this calm, colorful block puzzle.

Plegma is a classic shape puzzle. Place shapes on the 8×8 grid, fill whole rows or columns and clear them.

• 60 levels with growing goals
• Endless free play
• Free undo, hints and new shapes
• Four colour palettes
• Original music
• Progress is saved on your device

The game is free and shows a few ads: never at start, one full-screen ad every few levels.
spira: Aim, match three marbles and clear the spiral before it reaches the end.

Spira is a colourful marble shooter. Aim and match three or more marbles of the same colour to clear the chain before it reaches the centre.

• 60 levels on six different tracks
• Swap colours with one tap
• Relaxed speed for a calmer game
• Colour symbols so marbles are easy to tell apart
• No energy, no lives

The game is free and shows a few ads: never at start, one full-screen ad every few levels.
lumen: Chase the glow through shifting mazes in an original arcade adventure.

Explore three original maze layouts that repeat with rising speed and challenge. Collect glowing pellets, turn the tables on colorful pursuers, discover bonus crystals and master paired tunnels in later levels.

Swipe anywhere on the screen to steer (on-screen arrows can be switched on in the menu), pause when needed and chase your best score. An optional video gives you +1 life once per level.

The game is free and shows a few ads, never at start.
runner: Run through vivid worlds, master three bonus games and find your next horizon.

Find your line through twelve winding routes across cities, villages, jungle and skyline districts. Jump crates, slide under signs, change lanes around rocks and cross elevated river bridges.

Choose Easy, Medium or Hard. Each route offers about five minutes of active running, with speed increasing as you travel. Hard builds speed sooner; later routes raise the challenge in every mode.

Collect coins in your lane, jump for airborne trails and catch a temporary magnet. Discover three bonus games: Prism Breaker, Mosaic Drop and Sky Patrol. Play Stage 1 of every bonus game immediately in the standalone collection. Complete the twelve main routes to unlock Stages 2 and 3 of all three games. In-run rewards are scheduled: one break on routes 1–3, two on 4–8 and three on 9–12.

The game uses touch buttons and gestures. Progress and settings are saved on this device. Gameplay does not require a player account. There is no cloud-save transfer between devices.
